business_summary.text: Vimta Labs is a leading contract research and testing organization (CRTO) in India, offering services across pharma, biologics, food, agrochemicals, electronics, and environmental testing. The company has a strong global presence with 40% of its revenue coming from overseas.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹109.25 Cr (+15.7% YoY), net profit ₹21.11 Cr (+15.2% YoY).
Vimta Labs reported Q4FY26 revenue of ₹109.20 Cr and net profit of ₹21.10 Cr.

Vimta Labs Limited’s Board of Directors, led by **Sujani Vasireddi**, recommended a final dividend of ₹2 per equity share (face value ₹2) for FY2025-26, pending AGM approval, with record date 18 June 2026.
Sujani Vasireddi shared the Q4 FY 2025–26 earnings call recording link on May 6, 2026, via the company’s website.
Vimta Labs reported Q4 FY26 total income of ₹112 Cr (+16.6% YoY) and net profit of ₹21.1 Cr (+15.2% YoY).
Dr S P Vasireddi and Persons Acting in Concert declared no encumbrance on shares held during FY2025-26 under SEBI Regulation 31(4).
Q2FY27 results (standalone): revenue ₹111.98 Cr (+9.9% YoY), net profit ₹20.61 Cr (+3.5% YoY).
Vimta Labs reported Q2FY27 results with revenue of ₹112 Cr; and EBITDA margin of 35.5%.
Vimta Labs Limited shared the Q2 FY 2026-27 earnings call recording on 30 October 2026 via its website.
